description: This file defines the ClusterClientAdoNetStreamConfigurator class, which helps set up and configure an ADO.NET-based streaming provider for Orleans clients. It includes methods for configuring options, cache size, and partitioning for the stream provider.

classes.name: ClusterClientAdoNetStreamConfigurator
classes.description: A configurator class for setting up an ADO.NET stream provider on an Orleans client.

methods.name: ClusterClientAdoNetStreamConfigurator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the configurator with the stream provider name and client builder, and sets up dependency injection services.

methods.name: ConfigureAdoNet
methods.description: Allows additional configuration of ADO.NET stream options.

methods.name: ConfigureCache
methods.description: Configures the cache size for the stream provider.

methods.name: ConfigurePartitioning
methods.description: Configures the number of partitions (queues) for the stream provider.
